scope: Current portal control families and PDF diagram/graphic shapes; 1280/320 CSS-px, actual pointer hover/keyboard focus and state changes. Full 1.4.11 assessment within stated local representative sample.

baseline_ui.finding: One selected-fill snapshot transparent at beginning of real quarter-second transition; other tested necessary marks at least 3.392300:1.

additional_ui.note: Combined file retains 32 pre-fix states / 158 measurements and two post-fix states / six measurements. Historical failure is not a new after-fix breach. Unchanged control colours retained explicitly; 16 filter actions are the independent corrective retest.

limits: K is a scoped local work assessment, not formal global WCAG/production approval.
No actual screen reader, 200/400% zoom, physical orientation or production/auth/external-model test.
PDF visual classification does not resolve 1.1.1/1.3.1/1.3.2 or PDF language/reading order.
No claim that an edited PDF had objects removed; omission assessment is reasoned from visible content, geometry and explicit labels.
Actual held pointer-down not separately captured; current MUI ripple is disabled by theme and no author active-colour rules exist.
New graphics, controls, overlays or deployed authentication require reassessment.
